\newcommand{\ottdruleEXXProjTuple}[1]{\ottdrule[#1]{%

}{
\ottsym{\{} \, \ottcomplu{\ottnt{v_{\ottmv{i}}}}{\ottmv{i}}{{\mathrm{1}}}{..}{\ottmv{n}} \, \ottsym{\}}  \ottsym{.}  \ottmv{j}  \longrightarrow  \ottnt{v_{\ottmv{j}}}}{%
{\ottdrulename{E\_ProjTuple}}{}%
}}


\newcommand{\ottdruleEXXProjTp}[1]{\ottdrule[#1]{%
\ottpremise{\ottnt{t_{{\mathrm{1}}}}  \longrightarrow  \ottnt{t'_{{\mathrm{1}}}}}%
}{
\ottnt{t_{{\mathrm{1}}}}  \ottsym{.}  \ottmv{i}  \longrightarrow  \ottnt{t'_{{\mathrm{1}}}}  \ottsym{.}  \ottmv{i}}{%
{\ottdrulename{E\_ProjTp}}{}%
}}


\newcommand{\ottdruleEXXTuple}[1]{\ottdrule[#1]{%
\ottpremise{\ottnt{t}  \longrightarrow  \ottnt{t'}}%
}{
\ottsym{\{} \, \ottcomplu{\ottnt{v_{\ottmv{i}}}}{\ottmv{i}}{{\mathrm{1}}}{..}{\ottmv{m}} \, \ottsym{,}  \ottnt{t}  \ottsym{,} \, \ottcomplu{\ottnt{t_{\ottmv{j}}}}{\ottmv{j}}{{\mathrm{1}}}{..}{\ottmv{n}} \, \ottsym{\}}  \longrightarrow  \ottsym{\{} \, \ottcomplu{\ottnt{v_{\ottmv{i}}}}{\ottmv{i}}{{\mathrm{1}}}{..}{\ottmv{m}} \, \ottsym{,}  \ottnt{t'}  \ottsym{,} \, \ottcomplu{\ottnt{t_{\ottmv{j}}}}{\ottmv{j}}{{\mathrm{1}}}{..}{\ottmv{n}} \, \ottsym{\}}}{%
{\ottdrulename{E\_Tuple}}{}%
}}
